        (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e ++ [h1]) := by
    intro e

    | const m c => simp [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    | bvar m c => simp [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    | op m c t => simp [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    | fvar m c t => simp [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    | abs m t e ih => simpa [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] using ih
    | quant m qk t tr e ihtr ihe =>
        simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
        apply List.Subset.app
        · exact List.Subset.trans ihtr (by intro x hx; simp_all)

    | ite m c t f ihc iht ihf =>

    simp only [List.mem_append] at hx ⊢
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    exact Or.imp_left Or.inl (List.mem_append.mp (hab hx))
    exact Or.imp_left Or.inr (List.mem_append.mp (hcd hx))
  induction post with
  | abs m t e ih => exact ih
  | quant m qk t tr e ihtr ihe => exact h ihtr ihe
  | app m e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
      unfold substOld
      split
      split <;> simp
      exact h ih1 ih2
  | ite m c t f ihc iht ihf => exact h (h ihc iht) ihf
  | eq m e1 e2 ih1 ih2 => exact h ih1 ih2
  | _ => simp
